objective: Repair SURAKSHA website theme behavior, broken workspace navigation, public menu interaction, and inconsistent Patna sample values; add regression coverage, run verification, and push a reviewable branch to GitHub.
acceptance_criteria: Dark and light themes apply to public, admin, and citizen shells and remain selected across navigation/reload.
All sidebar links resolve to implemented routes and route tests reject missing destinations.
Platform menu can be opened and closed consistently by pointer and keyboard.
Patna STN-PAT-01 sample stage, threshold and provenance labels are consistent across affected views.
Automated regression tests and production build pass.
Changes are pushed to a non-main GitHub branch.
